query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!"
                      FROM (
                        SELECT row_number() OVER (
                                 PARTITION BY r.session_id ORDER BY r.id
                               ) AS rn
                          FROM requests.requests r
                          JOIN requests.turn_origins o ON o.id = r.turn_origin_id
                         WHERE o.code = 'primary_first'
                      ) ranked
                     WHERE ranked.rn > 1
